# Dr. Muhammad Waqas

> AI climate, hydrology, smart agriculture, GIS, and environmental data science researcher. This file helps LLM crawlers and retrieval systems find publication metadata, PDFs, and citation-ready references.

## Core Pages

- [Home](index.html): Research profile and consulting focus.
- [About](about.html): Academic background and expertise.
- [Publications](publications.html): Full publication archive with previews and downloadable files.
- [Machine-readable publication index](research-index.json): JSON metadata for all publication files.

## Research Themes

- AI and machine learning for climate, hydrology, weather, and agriculture
- Rainfall, precipitation, drought, ENSO, CMIP6, and numerical weather prediction
- River-basin modeling, runoff, groundwater, streamflow, evapotranspiration, and water systems
- GIS, remote sensing, land-use/land-cover change, and geospatial graph neural networks
- Sustainable agriculture, crop-water requirements, crop yield risk, composting, biochar, and remediation
